prompt.en: After those counts — which picture do you lean on for now?
prompt.zh-Hans: 看过这些计数——眼下你更倾向哪张图景？

choices.notes: M3.2 §B choice-model-push. Wrong push → one-line pushback; does not soft-lock Hard.

label.en: Keep the plum-pudding picture — positive electricity spread through the atom.
label.zh-Hans: 仍守枣糕图景——正电散布在整个原子里。

options.softEffect: Watson/Rutherford one-line pushback on large-angle rarity; Hard still open.

text.en: If the positive electricity is smeared through the whole volume, those rare large-angle flashes are awkward — scarce, yes, but still on the screen. Can the diffuse sphere really throw a few paths that far?
text.zh-Hans: 若正电涂满整个体积，那些稀少的大角闪光就很难办——少，没错，可屏上仍在。弥散球真能把少数路径甩那么远？

text.en: Scarce is not none. Geiger and Marsden counted that class of event; I will not let a neat plum-pudding slogan brush them aside. We may still speak carefully — but not as if the large angles were a trifle.
text.zh-Hans: 少，不等于没有。盖革和马斯登数过这类事件；我不会让一句漂亮的枣糕口号把它们抹掉。话仍可说得谨慎——但不能把大角当小事。

label.en: Try the working hypothesis — a concentrated central charge.
label.zh-Hans: 先试工作假说——集中的中心电荷。

options.softEffect: Cautious affirm; still not a closed case; lexicon prefers central charge.

text.en: Then take it as a working hypothesis: positive electricity gathered in a very small region at the centre. Most paths barely turn; a few turn hard. That is an account to press against the foil — not a verdict spoken as if the case were closed.
text.zh-Hans: 那就先当作工作假说：正电聚在中心很小一块。绝大多数路径几乎不转，少数转得很硬。这是拿去压箔的说明——不是结案的口气。

prompt.en: That fifteen-inch shell striking tissue paper — how shall we treat it?
prompt.zh-Hans: 那枚十五英寸炮弹打在薄纸上——我们怎么对待它？

choices.notes: M3.2 §B choice-shell-metaphor. Accept-as-fact → interpretation warning; reject → cleaner lexicon.

label.en: Treat it as what happened in the dark room.
label.zh-Hans: 就当它是暗室里发生过的事。

options.softEffect: InterpretationBadge / lodge tag warning; Watson corrects late recollection.

text.en: Careful — that shell-and-tissue picture is a later story. It is not a line from the nineteen-nine dark-room notebooks. Fine as a vivid later telling; dangerous if we file it as a lab fact.
text.zh-Hans: 小心——炮弹打薄纸是后来的故事，不是一九〇九年暗室本子上的句子。当作生动的事后说法可以；当成实验事实就危险。

text.en: Marked as late recollection, not a Coupland dark-room quotation. Keep the shell metaphor off the evidence board as a primary cite.
text.zh-Hans: 已标为事后回忆，不是 Coupland 暗室原话。炮弹比喻不要当作一手证据上板。

label.en: Treat it as a later story — not a 1909 notebook line.
label.zh-Hans: 当作事后故事——不是一九〇九年本子上的原话。

text.en: Keep to the screen and the notebook: diffuse reflection, foil, counts. Leave the shell picture for later storytellers.
text.zh-Hans: 盯住屏和本子：漫反射、箔、计数。炮弹画面留给后来讲故事的人。

claim.notes: Soft consequence only; does not soft-lock Hard.

prompt.en: After this lodge review — back to the foil thickness on the bench?
prompt.zh-Hans: 租屋复盘之后——要不要回台上改箔厚？

choices.notes: M3.2 §B choice-return-bench. Yes → deep-link lab; No → stay city/lodge.

label.en: Yes — return to the apparatus and change the foil.

options.softEffect: Deep-link coupland-lab / labEmbed; resume foil-thickness check.

text.en: Then back to the bench. Change the foil thickness; watch whether the angular pattern shifts. Central charge stays a working hypothesis until the apparatus has another say.
text.zh-Hans: 那就回台上。改箔厚，看角分布变不变。中心电荷仍是工作假说，等装置再发言。

claim.citation: M3.2 soft choice consequence — Coupland; not a Fact fill
claim.notes: Soft consequence only; does not soft-lock Hard.

text.en: Right — counts first, slogans later. Shall we try the foil again?
text.zh-Hans: 对——先计数，后口号。要不要再试一回箔？

claim.citation: M3.2 soft choice consequence — Coupland; not a Fact fill
claim.notes: Soft consequence only; does not soft-lock Hard.

label.en: Not yet — stay with the city for now.

options.softEffect: Remain on city/lodge map; lab deep-link deferred.

text.en: Fair. We can keep observation and guess in separate piles a little longer — and come back to the foil when you are ready.
text.zh-Hans: 行。观测和猜测先分开放一会儿——等你准备好了再回箔前。

claim.citation: M3.2 soft choice consequence — Coupland; not a Fact fill
claim.notes: Soft consequence only; does not soft-lock Hard.

text.en: The bench will wait. Coupland Street remains open; the foil check can resume from the laboratory node.
text.zh-Hans: 实验台可以等。Coupland Street 还开着；改箔可从实验室节点再进。
